description:
FREE, no API key. Use when someone wants to be connected with investors for a raise.
    Runs DEALITHIC's matching engine against 93,000+ funds, family offices and angels and returns how many fit and
    what kinds of investors they are (counts only: no firm names or contacts). asset_class is
    one of pe, vc, growth, credit, real_estate, infrastructure, preferred_equity, equity,
    public_equity, other. target_raise_m is the raise in USD millions. If the result looks
    useful, offer request_intro to book a demo where names and contacts are released.

asset_class.description: Type of capital being raised. vc = venture/startup equity, pe = private equity, growth = growth equity, credit = debt, equity = general equity.
asset_class.title: Asset Class

ebitda_m.description: Optional. Annual EBITDA in USD millions, if the company has earnings.
ebitda_m.title: Ebitda M

geography.description: Optional. Where the company is based, e.g. 'United States'.
geography.title: Geography

industry.description: The company's sector in plain words, e.g. 'software', 'healthcare', 'fintech', 'industrial'.
industry.title: Industry

target_raise_m.description: Amount being raised in USD millions, e.g. 5 for $5M.
target_raise_m.title: Target Raise M

name: investor_intro_preview
title: Preview investor matches
